_comment: Metrics and join keys are facts about THIS database, not instructions about
how to think, so they live beside the database rather than in the catalog's
source. A catalog that hardcodes `fct_orders` offers revenue metrics on a
cricket database, which is worse than offering none.
A database with no .catalog.json next to it simply gets table cards.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.description: Completed order value. Cancelled and refunded orders are excluded; including them overstates revenue.

metrics.name: avg_unit_price
metrics.description: Realised price per unit. Revenue divided by units -- not AVG(unit_price), which weights a one-unit order the same as a forty-unit one.
